t: Introduction and overview — South Dakota-class Battleship
name: Introduction and overview — South Dakota-class Battleship — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — South Dakota-class Battleship
description: Introduction and overview of the South Dakota-class Battleship: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The South Dakota class — four ships — packed battleship power into a compact 680-foot armored hull: nine 16-inch/45 guns with the best protection of any U.S. battleship. South Dakota fought at Santa Cruz and Guadalcanal; Massachusetts is a museum at Fall River. Baseline facts: U.S. battleship; 4 built; compact armored hull; nine 16-inch guns..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
